zh.name: Bryce Adelstein Lelbach
zh.roleOrg: NVIDIA 首席工程师
zh.bio: Bryce Adelstein Lelbach 长期从事编程语言、编译器和基础库开发，致力于让并行编程更易于使用。他是 NVIDIA 首席工程师，创立了核心 C++ 计算库团队，目前负责推动 NVIDIA 在编程语言、编译器和核心库方面路线图的 Vanguard Programming 团队。他曾担任 C++ 库演进工作组及美国编程语言标准委员会主席，并参与并发原语、并行算法、sender 和多维数组等标准工作。

en.bio: Charles Yang is a core technical instructor for Agentic AI and Physical AI at AMD China and an architect focused on AI ecosystem development.

zh.name: Charles Yang
zh.roleOrg: AMD AI 解决方案架构师
zh.bio: AMD 中国 Agentic AI 与 Physical AI 核心技术讲师，专注于 AI 生态建设与解决方案架构。

zh.name: Xun Wang
zh.roleOrg: 讲师

zh.name: Roy Wang
zh.roleOrg: 讲师

zh.name: George Wang
zh.roleOrg: 讲师

en.roleOrg: Ph.D. Student, Tsinghua University / Approaching AI

zh.name: Peilin Li
zh.roleOrg: 清华大学 / Approaching AI 博士生
zh.bio: 清华大学博士生，师从张明兴教授，也是 KTransformers 与 LLaMA-Factory 等开源项目的核心贡献者。研究方向包括 GPU–CPU 异构系统上的推理与微调，以及大规模集群推理优化。

zh.name: 王潇爽
zh.roleOrg: 字节跳动软件工程师
zh.bio: 字节跳动全球流量基础设施团队软件工程师，专注于虚拟机与 WebAssembly，并关注操作系统、分布式系统、云原生技术、边缘计算和无服务器架构。

en.roleOrg: Group Leader, Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems / ELLIS Institute Tübingen
en.bio: Shiwei Liu leads a research group at the Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems and is a Principal Investigator at the ELLIS Institute Tübingen. Previously, he was a Royal Society Newton International Fellow at the University of Oxford and a postdoctoral fellow at the University of Texas at Austin. He received his Ph.D. with Cum Laude honors from Eindhoven University of Technology in 2022. His work focuses broadly on the full lifecycle of large foundation models.

zh.name: 刘世伟
zh.roleOrg: 马克斯·普朗克智能系统研究所研究组负责人 / 图宾根 ELLIS 研究所首席研究员
zh.bio: 现任马克斯·普朗克智能系统研究所研究组负责人、图宾根 ELLIS 研究所首席研究员。曾获英国皇家学会牛顿国际学者资助，并先后在牛津大学和德州大学奥斯汀分校从事研究。2022 年以最高荣誉获得埃因霍温理工大学博士学位，研究涵盖大型基础模型的完整生命周期。

zh.name: 郑嘉琦
zh.roleOrg: 南京大学副教授、博士生导师
zh.bio: 南京大学计算机学院副教授、博士生导师，研究方向聚焦超节点互连系统。主持国家自然科学基金优秀青年科学基金、面上项目和青年项目，以及华为、阿里巴巴、字节跳动、腾讯等企业创新基金；在 SIGCOMM、NSDI、NeurIPS 等国际会议发表论文百余篇，多次获得 CCF 推荐国际会议最佳论文奖。

en.name: Quanshi Zhang
en.roleOrg: Associate Professor, Shanghai Jiao Tong University
en.bio: Quanshi Zhang is a tenured Associate Professor and Ph.D. advisor in the School of Computer Science at Shanghai Jiao Tong University. His internationally recognized research focuses on the interpretability of neural networks. He received his Ph.D. from the University of Tokyo in 2014 and conducted postdoctoral research at UCLA from 2014 to 2018. He is a recipient of the ACM China Rising Star Award and has served in editorial and senior program roles for TMLR, NeurIPS, ICML, IJCAI, AAAI, and CVPR.

zh.name: 张拳石
zh.roleOrg: 上海交通大学副教授、博士生导师
zh.bio: 上海交通大学计算机学院长聘副教授、博士生导师，入选国家级海外高层次人才引进计划，获 ACM China 新星奖。2014 年获东京大学博士学位，2014 至 2018 年在 UCLA 从事博士后研究，在神经网络可解释性方向取得多项具有国际影响力的成果，并担任 TMLR 责任编辑以及 NeurIPS、ICML 等会议领域主席。

zh.name: Sébastien Crozet
zh.roleOrg: Dimforge 创始人
zh.bio: Rust 生态中 nalgebra、Rapier 等知名开源库的创建者和维护者，长期专注于线性代数、几何与物理计算。他创立 Dimforge，致力于推动跨平台科学计算和 AI 的发展。

en.roleOrg: Associate Researcher, Shenzhen Institute of Artificial Intelligence and Robotics for Society
en.bio: Liuwang Kang received his Ph.D. in Computer Science from the University of Virginia, where he also conducted postdoctoral research. He previously worked as a Senior Project Scientist at VMASC and as a Staff Engineer at Baidu. He is now an Associate Researcher at the Shenzhen Institute of Artificial Intelligence and Robotics for Society, focusing on multi-agent coordination, 6G-enabled embodied intelligence, and complex-system simulation.

zh.name: Liuwang Kang
zh.roleOrg: 深圳市人工智能与机器人研究院副研究员
zh.bio: 获弗吉尼亚大学计算机科学博士学位，并在该校从事博士后研究。曾任美国 VMASC 高级项目科学家和百度高级工程师，现任深圳市人工智能与机器人研究院副研究员，研究方向包括多智能体协同、6G 赋能的具身智能和复杂系统仿真。

en.roleOrg: Associate Researcher, Shenzhen Institute of Artificial Intelligence and Robotics for Society
en.bio: Hongjun Zhou is an Associate Researcher at the Shenzhen Institute of Artificial Intelligence and Robotics for Society. His research focuses on robot perception, navigation, and bipedal robot control. He previously worked on service and home robot development at Alibaba and the ASUS Intelligent Robot Center.

zh.name: Hongjun Zhou
zh.roleOrg: 深圳市人工智能与机器人研究院副研究员
zh.bio: 深圳市人工智能与机器人研究院副研究员，研究方向包括机器人感知、导航和双足机器人控制。曾在阿里巴巴和华硕智能机器人中心参与服务机器人与家庭机器人研发。

zh.name: Tiberiu Socaci
zh.roleOrg: Makeitfuture 联合创始人兼 CEO
zh.bio: Makeitfuture 联合创始人兼 CEO，专注于利用 AI、Make.com、Airtable、n8n 和无代码工具帮助企业实现数字化转型与复杂流程自动化。其团队已交付超过 15,000 项自动化方案，并获 Make.com 评选为 2024 年度 AI 合作伙伴及欧洲、中东和非洲地区排名第一的无代码机构。他目前致力于构建能够从用户纠正中持续学习的自演进应用。

en.roleOrg: Head of EU Policy, OpenMined Foundation

zh.name: Peter Ide-Kostic
zh.roleOrg: OpenMined Foundation 欧盟政策主管
zh.bio: 负责 OpenMined Foundation 在欧洲的 AI 治理、数据政策和隐私增强技术事务，拥有超过 15 年的欧盟技术政策经验。其工作聚焦可信 AI、负责任的数据访问和欧洲技术主权，并以个人身份参与欧盟委员会前沿 AI 专家论坛。

en.name: Tianyi Han
en.roleOrg: Solution Architect and Open-Source Builder, Ailuros

zh.name: Tianyi Han
zh.roleOrg: Ailuros 解决方案架构师、开源开发者
zh.bio: 专注于 AI 系统、智能体治理和决策支持工具的解决方案架构师与开源开发者，也是开源智能体治理项目 Ailuros 的创建者。其工作通过运行时策略执行、可追溯性、验证和重放机制，推动 AI 系统实现可控、可审计和可复现。

zh.name: 许建志
zh.roleOrg: Ingora 创始人兼 CEO
zh.bio: Ingora 创始人兼 CEO，致力于打造面向儿童的新一代 AI 学习伙伴设备。此前在微软拥有超过 20 年产品领导经验，曾负责 SharePoint Copilot 与 Agent 等业务的产品战略和增长。目前探索智能体系统、教育与硬件的结合，以及 AI 伙伴如何重塑儿童的学习和成长方式。

zh.bio: 智谱 AI 技术布道师。

zh.bio: 马德里理工大学电信学院教授，倡导开放数据、开放协议和开源基础设施。研究聚焦通过分布式治理、可验证溯源与去中心化信任机制推进数据空间架构，并涉及 MLOps、大数据架构、云计算、下一代互联网和形式化方法。

zh.name: Satya Mallick
zh.roleOrg: OpenCV.org CEO
zh.bio: OpenCV.org CEO，长期从事人工智能、计算机视觉和机器学习领域的创业与研发。他曾联合创办 Sight Commerce，并打造服务超过一亿用户的 AI 产品；同时也是广受欢迎的计算机视觉与 AI 在线课程创作者。

en.roleOrg: Founder & CEO, Lumo AI Compliance & Advisory

zh.name: Kelly Policarpo
zh.roleOrg: Lumo AI Compliance & Advisory 创始人兼 CEO
zh.bio: AI 治理与欧盟市场准入专家，创立 Lumo AI Compliance & Advisory，帮助 AI 企业为进入欧洲市场做好准备。她拥有计算机科学和产品管理背景，专业领域涵盖 AI 合规、隐私、网络安全与产品战略，重点帮助企业理解欧盟《人工智能法案》及相关治理要求。

en.roleOrg: AI, Data & HPC Expert, LUMI AI Factory / CYFRONET AGH / European Commission

zh.name: Katarzyna Starosławska
zh.roleOrg: LUMI AI Factory / CYFRONET AGH / 欧盟委员会 AI、数据与高性能计算专家
zh.bio: 拥有超过 20 年技术、战略与创新经验的数据和 AI 专家，为企业董事会、公共机构及欧盟提供咨询。她关注数据质量、互操作性和跨行业协作，并参与欧盟委员会下一代互操作框架专家组、AI 科学工作组及 EuroHPC / LUMI AI Factory 等项目。

zh.name: Qinying Liao
zh.roleOrg: 微软首席项目经理
zh.bio: 拥有十余年微软 Azure AI 经验的资深 AI 产品负责人，专注于语音 AI 与语音智能体。具备产品战略、从零到一产品开发和全球商业化经验，致力于将前沿 AI 技术转化为可规模化的产品和长期业务价值。

en.bio: Feliana Citradewi is the Founder and CEO of Global AI Assembly.

zh.name: Feliana Citradewi
zh.roleOrg: Global AI Assembly 创始人兼 CEO
zh.bio: Global AI Assembly 创始人兼 CEO。

zh.name: Markus Tavenrath
zh.roleOrg: NVIDIA 开发者技术首席工程师
zh.bio: NVIDIA 开发者技术首席工程师，长期从事 GPU 实时光线追踪以及场景图、OpenGL、WebGL、Vulkan 和 AI 的性能优化。他是 Vulkan-Hpp 项目的联合创始人，现任 Khronos 机器学习委员会主席。

zh.name: Igor Schwarzmann
zh.roleOrg: Known Unknowns GmbH 负责人
zh.bio: 文化与技术交叉领域的战略顾问，拥有 20 年跨医疗、汽车、奢侈品、媒体和政府领域经验，曾服务全球科技公司、欧洲跨国企业及公共机构。他以开源、本地优先的智能体 AI 基础设施运营自己的咨询业务，并主持探讨文化现象与欧洲 AI 主权的播客 Follow the Rabbit。

en.name: CodingMa
en.bio: CodingMa holds a master's degree from Peking University and has worked extensively on training systems for NLP and large language models. At Huawei, he focuses on building the native open-source ecosystem for Ascend training, leads technical collaborations and planning with post-training communities, and contributes as a committer to LLaMA-Factory.

zh.name: CodingMa
zh.roleOrg: 华为开源训练软件技术专家
zh.bio: 硕士毕业于北京大学，长期从事 NLP 与大语言模型训练系统相关工作，负责昇腾训练方向的原生开源生态建设，参与并主导多个后训练社区的技术合作与规划，同时担任 LLaMA-Factory 社区 committer。

en.name: Anastasia Stasenko
en.bio: Anastasia Stasenko is Co-Founder and CEO of Pleias, a Franco-German lab developing data infrastructure for frontier AI systems. Under her leadership, Pleias created Common Corpus, an open multilingual dataset for LLM training with more than two trillion tokens, and led SYNTH, which produces open synthetic data at scale for sovereign AI models and agentic applications. She is also a Senior Associate Lecturer at Sorbonne Nouvelle University and came to AI through digital humanities and philosophy at the École Normale Supérieure.

zh.name: Anastasia Stasenko
zh.roleOrg: Pleias 联合创始人兼 CEO
zh.bio: 法德 AI 实验室 Pleias 联合创始人兼 CEO，负责面向前沿 AI 系统的数据基础设施。Pleias 创建了拥有超过两万亿 token 的开放多语言大模型训练数据集 Common Corpus，并通过 SYNTH 大规模生产用于主权 AI 模型和智能体应用的开放合成数据。她同时任巴黎第三大学高级副讲师，拥有数字人文和哲学背景。

zh.name: Pieter Delobelle
zh.roleOrg: 讲师

zh.bio: Hugging Face 机器学习研究工程师，专注于大语言模型训练。他是 SmolLM3 和 The Ultra Scale Playbook 的共同作者，研究涵盖自然语言处理、深度学习和可扩展 AI 基础设施。

zh.name: Martino Russi
zh.roleOrg: Hugging Face 具身机器人工程师
zh.bio: LeRobot 开源机器人库核心贡献者，负责构建和维护 Unitree G1 人形机器人技术栈，也是开源力反馈手部外骨骼 Project Homunculus 的创建者。他拥有神经科学、AI 和机器人学背景，致力于让具身智能技术更加普及。

en.name: Peng Zhang
en.bio: Peng Zhang is the founder of Genmeta Technology and an advocate for DHttp.

zh.name: 张鹏
zh.roleOrg: 建元科技创始人
zh.bio: 张鹏，建元科技创始人，DHttp 布道师。

en.name: Meiyi Qiang
en.bio: Meiyi Qiang is a core developer of the OpenDCAI open-source projects, with a focus on the DataFlow AI data preparation system and the DataFlex dynamic training system. Her work spans data-centric AI, data-model co-training, and dynamic data optimization. She has published seven papers in CCF-A journals and conferences and now leads AI data infrastructure solutions and commercialization as Co-Founder of Yuanshu Zhihui.

zh.name: 强美伊
zh.roleOrg: 元枢智汇联合创始人
zh.bio: OpenDCAI 系列开源项目核心技术开发者，重点参与 AI 数据准备系统 DataFlow 与动态训练系统 DataFlex 的研发与落地，研究方向涵盖 Data-Centric AI、数据—模型协同训练与动态数据优化。个人累计发表 CCF-A 类期刊及会议论文 7 篇，现作为元枢智汇联合创始人，负责 AI 数据基础设施的解决方案与商业落地。

en.name: Anni Lai
en.roleOrg: Generative AI Commons Co-Chair, LF AI & Data
en.bio: Anni Lai is Co-Chair of the Generative AI Commons and a board member of LF AI & Data.

zh.bio: Anni Lai 是 LF AI & Data 生成式 AI 公共社区联合主席，并担任 LF AI & Data 董事会成员。

en.name: Zhihong Mo
en.roleOrg: EDA Ecosystem & University Program Lead, JLC Technology Group
en.bio: Zhihong Mo is the higher-education manager and ecosystem platform lead at JLC Technology Group, as well as the initiator of the Open Source Hardware Platform. He works to expand the use of domestic PCB design tools in education and to build an open hardware ecosystem connecting developers, universities, and industry.

zh.name: 莫志宏
zh.roleOrg: 嘉立创 EDA 生态社区及大学计划负责人
zh.bio: 深圳嘉立创科技集团股份有限公司高校教育经理、生态平台负责人，立创开源硬件平台发起人。致力于国产 PCB 设计工具在教育领域的普及推广与开源硬件生态建设，主导平台从 0 到 1 的建设与运营，连接开发者、高校与产业。

zh.name: Bartłomiej Szejny
zh.roleOrg: AI Poland 董事会成员
zh.bio: 技术创业者、独立 AI 研究者及 AI Poland 董事会成员，致力于从商业、技术和战略角度推动波兰人工智能生态发展。他的研究聚焦自主具身智能体，以及受神经生物学启发的控制机制。

en.name: Sean Dong
en.roleOrg: Director of Product Management, Huawei Cangjie Programming Language Team

zh.name: 董鑫
zh.roleOrg: 华为仓颉编程语言团队产品管理总监
zh.bio: 曾任 Microsoft Azure 企业云专家，并负责华为移动 AI 工具、昇腾 MindStudio、HarmonyOS DevEco Studio 以及仓颉/毕昇 C 语言 IDE。自 2025 年初起探索 AI Agent 驱动的研发模式，并开源已被多个大型工程团队采用的 ACEHarness。

zh.name: Birgitta Böckeler
zh.roleOrg: 杰出工程师
zh.bio: 拥有 20 多年技术与软件咨询经验的软件开发者、架构师和技术负责人，长期观察组织和团队交付软件的成功与失败。她最近任职于 Thoughtworks，担任杰出工程师，并自 2023 年起专注于 AI 辅助软件交付。

en.name: Zixi Liu

zh.bio: 南京大学博士，华为 2012 实验室编程语言实验室员工，从事编程语言与 AI 相关研究。

en.name: Fahua Jin
en.bio: Fahua Jin is Co-Founder and CTO of EMQ, where he leads product and R&D. He has initiated and contributed to multiple open-source projects and previously worked as a Senior Architect at IBM China Software Development Lab.

zh.bio: EMQ 联合创始人兼 CTO，负责公司的产品与研发。多个开源项目的发起者和参与者，前 IBM 中国软件开发中心高级架构师。

zh.roleOrg: 讲师

zh.name: Chen Xin
zh.roleOrg: 华为工程师
zh.bio: openEuler Embedded SIG Maintainer，长期专注于嵌入式实时操作系统、异构计算与机器人软件栈。在 openEuler 社区中主导 IB-Robot、MICA 及 UniProton 等核心项目的架构设计与版本演进。

en.name: Zhichao Jiao

zh.bio: 声网开发者体验产品经理。

zh.bio: 软件顾问及开源嵌入式系统专家，拥有 20 多年开源嵌入式系统设计与开发经验。他是《Mastering Embedded Linux Programming》作者，也是 aosp-devs 开发者社区的主要推动者，曾多次在 Linux Foundation Embedded Linux Conference 和 FOSDEM 等会议演讲。

zh.name: 张凡石
zh.roleOrg: Moeru AI CTO
zh.bio: 全栈开发者和开源项目构建者，其项目累计获得超过 5 万颗 GitHub Star，工作领域涵盖 CNCF 生态、AI 训练与智能体技术。

zh.name: Rin
zh.roleOrg: 讲师

zh.name: Hsuan Han Lai
zh.roleOrg: 涂鸦智能开发者生态负责人
zh.bio: 涂鸦智能开发者生态负责人、TuyaOpen 开源项目技术负责人及 Agent OS Foundation 架构师，专注构建下一代智能体 AI 硬件框架，曾任 Vibe Inc. 产品工程总监。

en.name: Charbel Dandjinou
en.bio: Charbel Dandjinou is the founder and CTO of Reflexion Robotics, a Paris-based startup building A OS, a safety runtime for embodied AI. Previously an AI research engineer and MLOps technical lead at EXXACT Robotics, he also founded IROKO and the Deep Takka research lab to make AI more accessible and inclusive.

zh.name: Charbel Dandjinou
zh.roleOrg: Reflexion Robotics 创始人兼 CTO
zh.bio: Reflexion Robotics 创始人兼 CTO，致力于开发面向具身智能的安全运行时 A OS。曾任 EXXACT Robotics AI 研究工程师及 MLOps 技术负责人，并创立 IROKO 与 Deep Takka 研究实验室，推动 AI 技术普及与包容性发展。

en.name: Alba María Téllez Fernández
en.bio: Alba María Téllez Fernández is AI Lead at Marso Robotics and the main developer of the open-source simulation projects AlpaBridge and URDF Studio. She works at the intersection of world models, agentic AI, and cybersecurity for robotics and autonomous vehicles.

zh.name: Alba María Téllez Fernández
zh.roleOrg: Marso Robotics AI 负责人
zh.bio: Marso Robotics AI 负责人，也是开源仿真项目 AlpaBridge 与 URDF Studio 的主要开发者。她的工作聚焦世界模型、智能体 AI，以及机器人和自动驾驶系统的网络安全。

en.name: Xuewen Gao
en.roleOrg: Deputy Chief Engineer & Security Architect, QI-ANXIN
en.bio: Xuewen Gao is Deputy Chief Engineer and Security Architect at QI-ANXIN, with 20 years of experience in cybersecurity operations, product development, and solution architecture. His work spans DevSecOps, code security, SOAR, threat intelligence, security operations, data governance, and AI security.

zh.name: 高学文
zh.roleOrg: 奇安信副总工程师兼安全架构师
zh.bio: 从事网络空间安全实战攻防、产品研发及解决方案工作 20 年，主导设计与研发 DevSecOps、代码安全、SOAR、威胁情报、威胁分析和安全运营平台等产品。近年重点负责 AI 安全整体规划、数据分类分级、数据治理与 AI 安全研究，拥有十余项行业专利。

en.name: Yuning Liang
en.bio: Yuning Liang is the founder and CEO of DeepComputing, which develops RISC-V products including laptops, tablets, workstations, vehicles, and drones. He has a hands-on background in embedded systems, platform APIs, and system software, and received the RISC-V Community Contributor Award in 2024.

zh.name: 梁宇宁
zh.roleOrg: DeepComputing 创始人兼 CEO
zh.bio: DeepComputing 创始人兼 CEO，带领团队开发基于 RISC-V 的笔记本电脑、平板、工作站、遥控车和无人机等产品。他拥有嵌入式系统、平台 API 与系统软件实践经验，并于 2024 年获得 RISC-V 社区贡献者奖。

en.name: Yuu
en.bio: Yuu, also known as tommy0103, is the author of Obelisk, an open-source evidence layer that unifies coding-agent session history in a queryable SQLite index. Her work focuses on agent runtimes, CodeAct-style interfaces, local-first data layers, and the tooling needed for intensive multi-agent workflows.

zh.name: Yuu
zh.roleOrg: Dify 智能体性能与优化实习生
zh.bio: 开源项目 Obelisk 作者。该项目将多种编码智能体的会话历史统一到可查询的 SQLite 索引中。她的工作聚焦智能体运行时、CodeAct 风格交互、本地优先数据层，以及高强度多智能体工作流所需的工具。

en.name: Yaowei Zheng
en.bio: Yaowei Zheng is Co-Founder and CTO of PrismShadow and a Ph.D. student in computer science at Beihang University. He created the open-source LlamaFactory fine-tuning framework and now leads PenguinHarness, an open and transparent self-evolving agent engine designed to support more than 1,000 models.

zh.name: 郑耀威
zh.roleOrg: 千影光流联合创始人兼 CTO
zh.bio: 千影光流联合创始人兼 CTO、北京航空航天大学计算机学院博士研究生，开源大模型微调框架 LlamaFactory 作者。目前带领团队打造 PenguinHarness，一个面向 1000 多种模型的开源、透明智能体自进化引擎。

en.name: Vincent Caldeira
en.bio: Vincent Caldeira is Red Hat's APAC CTO and an Industry Visiting Scholar at Columbia University. With more than 20 years in financial-services technology, he works across open source, cloud-native systems, AI safety, sustainability, and digital sovereignty, and holds leadership roles in several Linux Foundation communities.

zh.name: Vincent Caldeira
zh.roleOrg: Red Hat 亚太区 CTO
zh.bio: Red Hat 亚太区 CTO、哥伦比亚大学产业访问学者，拥有二十多年金融科技经验。他长期关注开源、云原生系统、AI 安全、可持续发展与数字主权，并在多个 Linux Foundation 社区担任领导职务。

en.name: Tong Ling
en.roleOrg: Head of IoT Product Commercialization, Espressif Systems
en.bio: Tong Ling leads IoT product commercialization at Espressif Systems, advancing the ecosystem and commercial adoption of its open-source IoT platform. His interests span technology, business, philosophy, and human-centered product development.

zh.name: 凌通
zh.roleOrg: 乐鑫科技 IoT 产品商业化负责人
zh.bio: 现任乐鑫科技 IoT 产品商业化负责人，推动乐鑫开源 IoT 平台的生态建设与商业化落地，关注科技、商业、哲学与生活的交叉，并致力于创造有温度的产品与内容。

en.name: Xin Liu
en.bio: Xin Liu is a Principal Researcher at Huawei and the founder of Jiuwen Symbiosis.

zh.name: 刘鑫
zh.roleOrg: 华为首席研究员
zh.bio: 华为首席研究员、九问共生创始人。

en.name: Bo Tang
en.bio: Bo Tang leads applied algorithms at MemTensor and is responsible for the development and deployment of MemOS and ClawForce. His research spans natural language processing, reinforcement learning, and safe reinforcement learning, with extensive experience turning advanced algorithms into production systems.

zh.name: 唐波
zh.roleOrg: 记忆张量应用算法负责人
zh.bio: 现任记忆张量应用算法负责人，主要负责 MemOS 与 ClawForce 的技术研发及应用落地，长期从事自然语言处理、强化学习与安全强化学习研究，拥有丰富的前沿技术研究、核心算法研发及规模化业务落地经验。

en.name: Yanzhi Wang
en.bio: Yanzhi Wang is a professor of electrical and computer engineering at Northeastern University. His research focuses on real-time and energy-efficient deep learning and AI systems, particularly efficient large language models and large-scale generative AI systems.

zh.name: 王言治
zh.roleOrg: Northeastern University 教授
zh.bio: Northeastern University 电气与计算机工程教授，研究方向包括实时与高能效深度学习和人工智能系统，尤其关注高效大语言模型及大规模生成式 AI 系统。

en.name: Kerry Zhu
en.bio: Kerry Zhu is a professor at Tongji University and a Distinguished Member of the China Computer Federation. He has worked in software-engineering education and research for nearly three decades, with a focus on software testing, quality assurance, and intelligent software engineering.

zh.name: 朱少民
zh.roleOrg: 同济大学教授
zh.bio: 同济大学教授、中国计算机学会杰出会员，近三十年来从事软件工程教学与研究，重点关注软件测试、质量保障和智能软件工程，出版二十余部专著及多部译著。

en.name: Philipp Oppermann
en.bio: Philipp Oppermann is a freelance Rust developer from Germany working on the Dora robotics framework and operating-system development in Rust. He is the author of the Writing an OS in Rust blog and the main editor of the This Month in Rust OSDev newsletter.

zh.name: Philipp Oppermann
zh.roleOrg: 自由职业 Rust 开发者
zh.bio: 来自德国的自由职业 Rust 开发者，参与 Dora 机器人框架及 Rust 操作系统开发相关项目。他是 Writing an OS in Rust 博客作者，也是 This Month in Rust OSDev 月报的主要编辑。

en.name: Shuyue Hu
en.bio: Shuyue Hu is a research scientist at Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory. Her research focuses on agents, multi-agent systems, large language models, and game theory. She received her Ph.D. from the Chinese University of Hong Kong in 2019 and was a research fellow at the National University of Singapore. Her work has received the First Prize of the Natural Science Award from the Chinese Institute of Electronics, the DAI 2025 Best Paper Award, an AAMAS 2026 Best Student Paper nomination, and the AAMAS 2026 Best System Demonstration Award.

zh.name: 胡舒悦
zh.roleOrg: 上海人工智能实验室研究科学家
zh.bio: 上海人工智能实验室研究科学家，研究方向包括智能体、多智能体系统、大语言模型和博弈论。2019 年获香港中文大学博士学位，曾任新加坡国立大学研究员。其研究获得中国电子学会自然科学一等奖、DAI 2025 最佳论文奖、AAMAS 2026 最佳学生论文提名和最佳系统演示奖。

en.name: Che Jiang
en.roleOrg: Ph.D. Candidate & Algorithm Researcher, Tsinghua University / Frontis.AI
en.bio: Che Jiang is a Ph.D. candidate at Tsinghua University and an Algorithm Researcher at Frontis.AI. His research focuses on AI4AI, self-evolving agents, automated machine learning engineering, and AI for scientific discovery. His recent work includes NatureBench and Frontis-MA1/OpenMLE.

zh.name: 姜澈
zh.roleOrg: 清华大学博士研究生、衔远科技算法研究员
zh.bio: 清华大学博士研究生、衔远科技算法研究员，研究方向包括 AI4AI、自进化智能体、自动化机器学习工程和 AI for Science。近期工作包括 NatureBench 与 Frontis-MA1/OpenMLE。

zh.name: 张开颜
zh.roleOrg: 联合讲师

en.name: Ning Liu
en.roleOrg: Algorithm Expert, Beijing Innovation Center of Humanoid Robotics
en.bio: Ning Liu earned his Ph.D. from Northeastern University in the United States. He has published more than 40 papers in leading conferences and journals, including NeurIPS, CVPR, ICML, and IEEE TNNLS, and chairs the IEEE Standards Working Group on AI for Edge Devices.

zh.name: 刘宁
zh.roleOrg: 北京人形机器人创新中心算法专家
zh.bio: 刘宁博士毕业于美国东北大学，在 NeurIPS、CVPR、ICML、IEEE TNNLS 等国际顶级会议和期刊发表论文 40 余篇，并担任 IEEE 边缘设备人工智能标准工作组主席。

en.name: Yuegang Liu
en.roleOrg: Vice Principal, Sun Yat-sen University Affiliated School (Shenzhen)
en.bio: Yuegang Liu is a senior secondary-school art teacher and Vice Principal of Sun Yat-sen University Affiliated School in Shenzhen. Over more than 20 years in education, he has worked on school culture, brand and design management, and AI-supported collaborative learning. He developed the Three-Person Learning Group model, combining Confucian differentiated instruction with Vygotsky's zone of proximal development through intelligent grouping, collaborative inquiry, and multidimensional assessment.

zh.name: 刘月刚
zh.roleOrg: 中山大学深圳附属学校副校长
zh.bio: 中学美术高级教师、中山大学深圳附属学校副校长，深耕深圳教育二十余年。长期研究学校文化、品牌与形象管理，并提出“学习沐城”理念和“三人行”小组合作式学习模型，以因材施教和最近发展区理论为基础，探索智能分组、协作探究与多维评估在 AI 时代的应用。

en.name: Susanna Wong
en.bio: Susanna Wong is a Staff AI Engineer at Typeform, building products with cutting-edge AI. Her software-engineering experience spans startups and global companies, with expertise in web development, GraphQL, and generative AI. She is a Google Developer Expert in web technologies, serves on the Google Developer Advisory Board, and has spoken at conferences worldwide.

zh.name: Susanna Wong
zh.roleOrg: Typeform 资深 AI 工程师
zh.bio: Typeform 资深 AI 工程师，负责前沿人工智能产品研发。她拥有跨初创公司与全球企业的软件工程经验，专长涵盖 Web 开发、GraphQL 和生成式 AI。她也是 Google Web 技术开发者专家、Google Developer Advisory Board 成员，并曾在多场国际技术大会发表演讲。

en.name: Sean Dong
en.roleOrg: Program Director, Huawei Programming Language Lab
en.bio: Sean Dong is a Program Director at Huawei Programming Language Lab, leading core technology development for programming languages and IDE infrastructure. He previously worked on Microsoft Azure and Dynamics 365, and later led initiatives across Huawei's mobile AI tools, Ascend AI toolchain, HarmonyOS toolchain, and company-wide AI development platforms.

zh.name: 董鑫
zh.roleOrg: 华为编程语言实验室项目总监
zh.bio: 现任华为编程语言实验室项目总监，负责编程语言与 IDE 基础软件的核心技术研发。曾参与 Microsoft Azure、Dynamics 365，以及华为移动 AI 研发工具、昇腾 AI 芯片工具链、HarmonyOS 工具链和公司级 AI 研发平台建设。

en.name: Gregory Terzian
en.bio: Gregory Terzian is the founder of FOSS (Shanghai) Technology Consulting and a maintainer of the Servo browser engine.

zh.name: Gregory Terzian
zh.roleOrg: FOSS（上海）技术咨询创始人
zh.bio: FOSS（上海）技术咨询创始人，也是 Servo 浏览器引擎维护者。

en.name: Tess Kassier
en.bio: Tess Kassier is a Yale Ventures Entrepreneur-in-Residence, founder, and fractional go-to-market and ecosystem lead at RiseLink, the US innovation arm of Beken. She helps early-stage companies turn product learning into enterprise sales and global hyperscaler partnerships.

zh.name: Tess Kassier
zh.roleOrg: RiseLink 外部 GTM 与生态负责人
zh.bio: Yale Ventures 驻校企业家、创业者，并担任 RiseLink 外部市场进入与生态负责人。RiseLink 是博通集成在美国的创新业务平台。她擅长帮助早期企业将产品经验转化为企业销售和全球云服务合作伙伴关系。

en.name: Yuheng Chen
en.roleOrg: AI Researcher & Embedded Systems Specialist, ambi
en.bio: Yuheng Chen is a serial entrepreneur, AI researcher, and embedded-systems specialist at ambi. Since 2022, he has explored Rust for embedded product development and helped deliver more than 30 software and hardware products. His current work focuses on combining Rust and AI to create AI-native embedded products and new end-to-end development workflows.

zh.name: 陈昱衡
zh.roleOrg: ambi AI 研究员、嵌入式专家
zh.bio: 连续创业者，现任 ambi AI 研究员与嵌入式专家。自 2022 年起持续探索 Rust 在嵌入式产品研发中的应用，推动三十余款软硬件产品落地。当前专注于 Rust 与 AI 的融合，探索 AI 原生嵌入式产品及全流程研发的新范式。

en.name: Jiechen Liu
en.roleOrg: Director of Ecosystem & Technology, Magic Data
en.bio: Jiechen Liu is Director of Ecosystem and Technology and Head of Algorithm Engineering at Magic Data. He leads AI data infrastructure, industry AI solutions, and ecosystem partnerships, with a focus on embodied intelligence and voice agents for intelligent cockpits and home-service robots. His expertise includes multimodal dataset construction, voice-interaction optimization, domain-shift mitigation, and compliant data strategies.

zh.name: 刘杰辰
zh.roleOrg: Magic Data 生态与技术总监、算法工程负责人
zh.bio: Magic Data 生态与技术总监、算法工程负责人，负责 AI 数据基础设施、行业解决方案和跨行业生态合作。其工作聚焦具身智能，以及智能座舱和家庭服务机器人等设备中的语音智能体，专长包括多模态高质量数据集建设、语音交互优化、域偏移缓解和合规数据策略。

en.name: Michael Berns
en.bio: Michael Berns is Head of AI at the Eclipse Foundation. With more than 23 years of international experience, he works at the intersection of open-source AI, digital transformation, and global ecosystem development, advancing vendor-neutral innovation, transparent technology standards, and digital sovereignty.

zh.name: Michael Berns
zh.roleOrg: Eclipse Foundation 人工智能负责人
zh.bio: Eclipse Foundation 人工智能负责人，拥有二十余年国际经验，长期从事开源 AI、数字化转型和全球生态建设，致力于推动厂商中立的创新、透明技术标准和数字主权。

en.name: Cen Ming
en.roleOrg: Professor, Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications
en.bio: Cen Ming is a professor at Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications. He received his Ph.D. in optical engineering from the Graduate School of the Chinese Academy of Sciences in 2006. His research interests include information fusion, multi-target tracking, autonomous driving, and intelligent robotics.

zh.name: 岑明
zh.roleOrg: 重庆邮电大学教授
zh.bio: 重庆邮电大学教授，2006 年获中国科学院研究生院光学工程博士学位。研究方向包括信息融合、多目标跟踪、自动驾驶和智能机器人。

en.name: Baofeng Wang
en.roleOrg: Co-founder, Shanghai Mood Perception Intelligence Technology
en.bio: Baofeng Wang is a co-founder of Shanghai Mood Perception Intelligence Technology and holds an EMBA from Shanghai Jiao Tong University's Antai College. With more than 20 years of experience across internet and technology businesses, he now focuses on brain-computer interfaces, AI wearables, and agentic devices that bring perception, understanding, and feedback into real-world human-computer interaction.

zh.name: 王宝峰
zh.roleOrg: 上海心境感知智能科技联合创始人
zh.bio: 上海心境感知智能科技联合创始人、上海交通大学安泰 EMBA，拥有二十余年互联网及科技行业经验。当前专注于脑机接口、AI 可穿戴与智能体设备的产品创新，探索通过感知、理解与反馈创造新一代人机交互体验。

en.name: Chenzhe Jing
en.roleOrg: Head of Open Source Ecosystem, ModelBest
en.bio: Chenzhe Jing leads the open-source ecosystem at ModelBest and supports the company's Chief Scientist. He also leads advocacy and operations for the OpenBMB community. His work spans developer communities, industry partnerships, on-device large models, intelligent hardware, and the commercialization of AI technology.

zh.name: 井晨哲
zh.roleOrg: 面壁智能开源生态负责人
zh.bio: 面壁智能开源生态负责人、首席科学家助理，同时负责 OpenBMB 开源社区布道和运营。其工作涵盖开发者社区、产业合作、端侧大模型、智能硬件及 AI 技术产业化。

en.name: Iaroslav Neverov
en.bio: Iaroslav Neverov is a full-stack engineer at Pleias, a Paris-based AI company building the data layer for enterprise agentic AI. An École 42 graduate, he co-authored Pleias research on local, offline AI for knowledge work, including retrieval and RAG pipelines running on low-cost hardware.

zh.name: Iaroslav Neverov
zh.roleOrg: Pleias 全栈工程师
zh.bio: 巴黎 AI 公司 Pleias 全栈工程师，参与企业智能体 AI 数据层建设。毕业于 École 42，并参与 Pleias 本地离线知识工作 AI 研究，探索在低成本硬件上运行检索与 RAG 流程。

en.name: Bohua Zhan
en.roleOrg: Technical Expert, Huawei Programming Language Lab
en.bio: Bohua Zhan is a technical expert at Huawei Programming Language Lab. He earned his Ph.D. in mathematics from Princeton University in 2014 and later held postdoctoral positions at MIT and the Technical University of Munich. His research covers automated reasoning, interactive theorem provers, embedded-system modeling and verification, and applications in operating systems, distributed systems, and quantum programs.

zh.name: 詹博华
zh.roleOrg: 华为编程语言实验室技术专家
zh.bio: 华为编程语言实验室技术专家，2014 年获普林斯顿大学数学博士学位，后在麻省理工学院和慕尼黑工业大学从事博士后研究。研究方向包括证明自动化、交互式定理证明器、嵌入式系统建模与验证，以及程序验证、操作系统、分布式系统和量子程序验证。

en.name: Weiqi Zhao
en.roleOrg: Global Head of Open Ecosystem, Rokid
en.bio: Weiqi Zhao leads Rokid's global developer and partner ecosystem for AI and AR glasses. A serial entrepreneur in China and the United States, he has spent more than a decade building intelligent-hardware and spatial-computing products. His current work focuses on agentic AI, human-computer interaction, open standards, developer platforms, and human-centered wearable computing.

zh.name: 赵维奇
zh.roleOrg: Rokid 全球开放生态负责人
zh.bio: 负责 Rokid AI 与 AR 眼镜的全球开发者及合作伙伴生态，拥有十余年智能硬件与空间计算产品经验。当前关注智能体 AI、人机交互、开放标准、开发者平台及以人为中心的可穿戴计算。

en.name: Yi Ru
en.bio: Yi Ru is the founder and CEO of Lawaken Technology and a veteran smart-hardware entrepreneur with more than 20 years of consumer-electronics experience. He previously led intelligent terminals at Alibaba AI Labs, served as General Manager of Tmall Genie, and was a partner at Xiaomi TV. He founded Lawaken in 2021 to develop AI-powered consumer electronics and smart glasses.

zh.name: 茹忆
zh.roleOrg: 李未可科技创始人兼 CEO
zh.bio: 李未可科技创始人兼 CEO，拥有二十余年消费电子行业经验。曾任阿里巴巴人工智能实验室智能终端负责人、天猫精灵产品总经理及小米电视合伙人。2021 年创立李未可科技，专注于 AI 与消费电子融合及智能眼镜产品创新。

en.name: Chao Du
en.bio: Chao Du leads the openvela open-source project at Xiaomi. He has more than a decade of experience in open-source and ecosystem operations across cloud computing and telecommunications, and previously founded the IMGeek developer community.

zh.name: 杜超
zh.roleOrg: 小米 openvela 开源项目负责人
zh.bio: 小米 openvela 开源项目负责人，在云计算和通信行业拥有十余年开源及生态运营经验，曾创办 IMGeek 开发者社区。

en.name: Willem Jiang
en.roleOrg: Independent Open Source & Agentic AI Consultant
en.bio: Willem Jiang is an independent open-source and agentic AI consultant and a maintainer of DeerFlow. He previously worked at ByteDance's OSPO, served on the Apache Software Foundation Board of Directors, and contributed to Apache Camel, CXF, ServiceMix, and ServiceComb. His earlier roles include open-source technical expert at Huawei and Principal Engineer at Red Hat.

zh.name: 姜宁
zh.roleOrg: 独立开源与智能体 AI 顾问
zh.bio: 独立开源与智能体 AI 顾问、DeerFlow 维护者。曾任字节跳动 OSPO 开源布道师和 Apache 软件基金会董事，并长期参与 Apache Camel、CXF、ServiceMix 与 ServiceComb 等项目。此前曾任华为开源技术专家及 Red Hat 首席工程师。

en.name: Xin Tan
en.bio: Xin Tan is a Solutions Architect at Google Cloud, focusing on applications of frontier AI technologies in the gaming industry.

zh.name: 谭欣
zh.roleOrg: Google Cloud 解决方案架构师
zh.bio: Google Cloud 解决方案架构师，专注于 AI 前沿技术在游戏行业的应用。

en.name: An Chen
en.roleOrg: Co-founder, Chairman & CEO, Shenzhen Zhiweitong Technology
en.bio: An Chen is a co-founder, Chairman, and CEO of Shenzhen Zhiweitong Technology and Deputy Director of the Microfluidic Green Manufacturing R&D Center at the Research Institute of Tsinghua University in Shenzhen. He holds a Ph.D. from Tsinghua University and has led research and commercialization work in microfluidics, liquid cooling, and edge AI computing equipment.

zh.name: 陈安
zh.roleOrg: 深圳智微通科技联合创始人、董事长兼 CEO
zh.bio: 清华大学博士、博士后，现任深圳清华大学研究院微流控绿色制造研发中心副主任、深圳智微通科技有限公司联合创始人、董事长兼 CEO。长期从事微流控、液冷及端侧 AI 算力设备的研发与产业化。

en.name: Keshu Han
en.roleOrg: Embodied AI Developer, Beijing Dora Intelligence
en.bio: Keshu Han is an embodied AI developer and a contributor to the DORA community.

zh.name: 韩可树
zh.roleOrg: 北京道瑞智能具身智能开发者
zh.bio: 具身智能开发者，DORA 社区贡献者。

en.name: Jiarui Li
en.bio: Jiarui Li is the founder and CEO of Juzi.bot and a serial entrepreneur with more than a decade of experience in AI. A Microsoft AI MVP and Regional Director, she is a pioneer and advocate for enterprise agentic AI employees in China. Juzi.bot's products serve more than a thousand large enterprises and government organizations across retail, public services, finance, internet, and education.

zh.name: 李佳芮
zh.roleOrg: 句子互动创始人兼 CEO
zh.bio: 句子互动创始人兼 CEO，深耕 AI 十余年，是国内企业级 Agentic AI 员工领域的开拓者与技术布道者。她是微软 AI MVP、Regional Director，句子互动产品已在千余家大型企业及政府机构落地。

en.name: Canran Tang
en.roleOrg: Graduate Student, University of Science and Technology of China
en.bio: Canran Tang is a graduate student at the University of Science and Technology of China. His research focuses on embodied-intelligence infrastructure, robotic middleware, heterogeneous GPU communication, and efficient data exchange for end–edge–cloud robot inference.

zh.name: Canran Tang
zh.roleOrg: 中国科学技术大学研究生
zh.bio: 中国科学技术大学研究生，研究方向包括具身智能基础设施、机器人中间件、异构 GPU 通信，以及端—边—云机器人推理中的高效数据交换。

en.name: Yang Li
en.bio: Yang Li is the technical lead of the DORA community and a core DORA developer. He is also a core Huawei CANN developer, an M-Robots PMC member, and a core member of the OpenLoong Middleware SIG. He works on embodied-intelligence robot systems and the development and growth of the DORA ecosystem.

zh.name: 李扬
zh.roleOrg: DORA 社区技术负责人
zh.bio: DORA 社区技术负责人、DORA 核心开发者，同时是华为 CANN 核心开发者、M-Robots PMC 委员及 OpenLoong 中间件 SIG 核心成员，长期从事具身智能机器人系统研发及 DORA 生态建设。

en.name: Jiang Tao
en.bio: Jiang Tao is the founder and chairman of CSDN and the initiator of GOSIM. Across more than 30 years in software, the internet, and entrepreneurship, he has led products including Giant Handwriting Computer, Kingsoft PowerWord, and Super Decoder, founded Programmer Magazine, and invested in more than 80 technology startups.

zh.name: 蒋涛
zh.roleOrg: CSDN 创始人兼董事长、GOSIM 发起人
zh.bio: CSDN 创始人兼董事长、GOSIM 发起人，拥有三十余年软件、互联网与创业经验。曾参与巨人手写电脑、金山词霸和豪杰超级解霸等产品，创办《程序员》杂志，并投资八十余家科技创业公司。

en.name: Zhenwei Pi
en.bio: Zhenwei Pi is the founder of Tensorfer, an AI infrastructure startup. He previously co-founded the compute pillar of ByteDance's IaaS business and is a long-time Linux kernel and QEMU contributor. His current work focuses on system-level performance bottlenecks in large-scale LLM inference, including GPUDirect RDMA weight loading and distributed scheduling.

zh.name: Zhenwei Pi
zh.roleOrg: Tensorfer 创始人
zh.bio: AI 基础设施创业公司 Tensorfer 创始人，曾联合创建字节跳动 IaaS 业务的计算体系，也是长期的 Linux 内核与 QEMU 贡献者。当前专注于大规模大模型推理中的系统级性能瓶颈，包括 GPUDirect RDMA 权重加载与分布式调度。

en.name: Yuchao Qian
en.bio: Yuchao Qian is the co-founder of Raft.build, a multiplayer, multi-agent collaboration platform. He previously created Kimi CLI and NoneBot and has contributed to open-source communities for many years.

zh.name: 钱宇超
zh.roleOrg: Botiverse 联合创始人兼 CEO
zh.bio: 多人多智能体群聊协作平台 Raft.build 联合创始人，曾开发 Kimi CLI 与 NoneBot，长期参与开源社区建设。

en.name: Weiyang Liu
en.roleOrg: Assistant Professor, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
en.bio: Weiyang Liu is an Assistant Professor at The Chinese University of Hong Kong.

zh.name: Weiyang Liu
zh.roleOrg: 香港中文大学助理教授
zh.bio: 香港中文大学助理教授。

en.name: Cong Wang
en.bio: Cong Wang is a software engineer at Huawei Technologies specializing in KV-cache acceleration for large-language-model inference. His work spans high-performance computing, inference acceleration, and AI infrastructure. He currently leads architecture design, core development, and open-source community work for UCM, Huawei's Unified Cache Manager.

zh.name: 王聪
zh.roleOrg: 华为技术有限公司软件工程师
zh.bio: 王聪是华为技术有限公司软件工程师，专注于大语言模型推理中的 KV Cache 加速、高性能计算与 AI 基础设施。目前负责统一缓存管理器 UCM 的架构设计、核心功能开发与开源社区运营。

en.name: Jianzhong Li
en.roleOrg: President, Singularity Intelligence Research Institute / Senior Vice President, CSDN
en.bio: Jianzhong Li is President of the Singularity Intelligence Research Institute and Senior Vice President of CSDN. He founded the Singularity Intelligence Technology Summit in 2016 and focuses on artificial intelligence, technology innovation, industrial ecosystems, and shifts in the AI product paradigm. He is also a member of the ISO C++ standards community.

zh.name: Jianzhong Li
zh.roleOrg: 奇点智能研究院院长 / CSDN 高级副总裁
zh.bio: Jianzhong Li 现任奇点智能研究院院长、CSDN 高级副总裁，长期关注人工智能、技术创新、产业生态与 AI 产品范式变迁。他于 2016 年发起奇点智能技术峰会，并参与 ISO C++ 标准社区工作。

zh.name: Emily Chen
zh.roleOrg: RoboChallenge 联合创始人
zh.bio: Emily Chen 负责 Dexmal 的开源战略与生态，并推动 RoboChallenge 评测平台和赛事体系建设。她长期参与全球开源社区，曾任开源社负责人，也是中国开源年度报告、COSCon 等项目的发起者之一，近年来专注于具身智能的真实机器人评测与开放基准。

en.name: Haibin Zhang
en.roleOrg: AI Infrastructure & Open Source Lead, Dexmal

zh.name: Haibin Zhang
zh.roleOrg: Dexmal AI 基础设施与开源负责人
zh.bio: Haibin Zhang 负责 Dexmal 的 AI 基础设施以及 OpenDM、Dexbotic 等开源项目，当前专注于具身智能领域可扩展的数据、训练、评测与推理基础设施，曾参与 Brain++、MegEngine 和自动驾驶基础设施建设。

zh.name: Longhang Deng
zh.roleOrg: 东南大学硕士研究生
zh.bio: Longhang Deng 是东南大学硕士研究生，研究方向包括智能体操作系统与智能体安全，重点探索能够为内核漏洞自动生成并验证运行时防护的自主智能体。
